C0066.title: Hainan Man Sentenced for Fraud via Fake Second-Hand Billiard Cue Ads
C0066.summary: A man surnamed Lao from Lingao County, Hainan, posted fake advertisements for second-hand billiard cues on social platforms to defraud a victim surnamed Yin. After gaining the victim's trust, he tricked them into transferring money through multiple methods. Lao was sentenced to four months of criminal detention and fined 1,000 yuan.
